title: Wire intra-workspace dependencies (namespace-package layout)
prompt: Convert all five workspace packages (core, log, api, cli, ui) from the underscore src-layout (src/agent_debate_<pkg>/) to a shared PEP 420 implicit namespace-package layout (src/agent_debate/<pkg>/), so each surface is imported as agent_debate.<pkg>. The agent_debate/ directory must NOT contain an __init__.py so the namespace merges across all five distributions. Update each package's pyproject.toml hatchling wheel target to packages = ["src/agent_debate"]. Wire the intra-workspace dependencies (issue #3 [0.3]): core depends on log; api/cli/ui depend on both core and log, declared via [project] dependencies + [tool.uv.sources] workspace sources. Prove the edges resolve at runtime: log exposes LIBRARY_VERSION/log_version, core re-exports log_version, and api/cli/ui re-export core_version and log_version by importing across the edge. Update tests to the new agent_debate.<pkg> imports and add tests/test_cross_package_imports.py asserting cross-package imports and that the namespace merges (two subpackages importable together). Configure mypy (namespace_packages, explicit_package_bases, mypy_path) so it resolves agent_debate.<pkg>. Verify all gates green: uv sync, ruff check, ruff format --check, uv run mypy, uv run pytest --cov (>=85%). Then commit with Closes #3, push, open a PR.
